name: Rolling for Romance
source:
Rolling for Romance is a Slice-of-Life dating sim where you find companionship through the magical world of Dungeons and Dragons! Go through your first year of college as you make friends, bond with your fellow club members, and potentially roll your way into one of their hearts!

[from [url=https://hermits-house.itch.io/rolling-for-romance]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Rolling for Romance》是一款日常题材恋爱模拟游戏，你将在《龙与地下城》的魔法世界中结识伙伴！度过大学第一年，交朋友，与社团成员培养感情，说不定还能掷出一段恋情，走进某个人的心！

[摘自[url=https://hermits-house.itch.io/rolling-for-romance]itch.io[/url]]
